source_note: 仅据 text/ 原文通读，未读 md

events.did: 带小队潜入敌后执行定点清除任务，按命令只能暗杀目标而不能直接炸掉整片建筑
events.quote_anchor: unable to simply raze the place because their orders were to pick him off, and make it look like in-fighting instead of execution.

events.did: 赶到目标地点时发现目标已经死于心脏病发作
events.quote_anchor: the target was already dead—a heart attack, what fucking luck—and even now, he had no idea if it had always been a trap

events.did: 用最后两发子弹击毙从屋顶上扫射的射手
events.quote_anchor: He was almost out of ammo, but he used his last two shots to pick off a shooter raining bullets from the rooftop overhead.

events.did: 躲开来袭手榴弹时被爆炸掀飞，撞上对面墙壁
events.quote_anchor: It threw him into the opposite wall, ears ringing and vision going black, then white, then black again.

events.did: 拖着重伤的身体爬进两栋建筑之间的窄缝里躲藏
events.quote_anchor: he dragged his half-dead body, his bleeding guts, his broken limbs, into a narrow gap between two structures

events.did: 被撤离队找到后在手术台上躺了六小时，又在重症监护室待了六周，最终活了下来
events.quote_anchor: Six hours on a table, his chest open to the world. Six weeks in intensive care. But he survived.

events.did: 在车厢里通过耳麦要求 Noah Harris 无论发生什么都要让那个女孩活着
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel kept talking. “You’re approaching the site. No matter what happens, I want the girl alive.”

events.did: 下令让其他特工列队，和另一个 EO 一起朝旅馆方向前进
events.quote_anchor: Noah gave the signal, and the other agents fell into formation as the two EOs made their way toward the motel.

relations.did: 不信任另一个 EO，因为战场上的兄弟必须彼此信任
relations.quote_anchor: He didn’t trust the other EO, and if Noah had learned anything during his black ops years, it was that you had to trust your brothers in the field.

relations.did: 毕生都在清剿 EO，被抓之后仍然如此
relations.quote_anchor: Eli had devoted his entire life to exterminating EOs. Before and after he was caught.

relations.did: 与 Dr. Gray 意见不合的时刻，是唯一能感到对方控制自己的时刻
relations.quote_anchor: There were moments—albeit rare—when Noah disagreed with Gabriel. Those moments were the only times he felt the other man’s control.

relations.did: 反对放出 Eli，向 Dr. Gray 表示自己已经为 EON 服役过
relations.quote_anchor: “The difference, sir,” said Noah, “is that I already served EON.”

numbers.did: 这次任务一共是 Six soldiers 深入敌后
numbers.quote_anchor: Six soldiers, behind enemy lines, buildings so tight the snipers couldn’t get a shot.

numbers.did: 在几乎没弹药的情况下打了 last two shots 击毙屋顶射手
numbers.quote_anchor: He was almost out of ammo, but he used his last two shots to pick off a shooter raining bullets from the rooftop overhead.

numbers.did: 被救回后在手术台上躺了 Six hours，胸口敞开
numbers.quote_anchor: Six hours on a table, his chest open to the world.

numbers.did: 在重症监护室待了 Six weeks 后活了下来
numbers.quote_anchor: Six weeks in intensive care. But he survived.

numbers.did: 车厢里有两个特工（Two agents）坐在 Noah 对面，两侧还各有一个
numbers.quote_anchor: Two agents—Kline and Weaver—sat across from him, another one on either side, their visors down, their faces hidden.
